tickets.title: Sweep: Dead code sweep of tycenjmccann/ember (detect, verify, remove, prove, PR)
tickets.description:
Repo: tycenjmccann/ember | Base: main | Work branch: sweep/dead-code-2026-08-31
Requirements doc: s3 workflows/wf_1788175925679_iczquj/shared/requirements.md (READ FIRST — contains full FRs/ACs and repo facts)

ONE ticket — do the entire sweep. NEVER auto-merge anything.

REPO FACTS (verified 2026-08-31):
- Next.js 14 App Router + TypeScript, source in src/; Tailwind.
- Nested second TS project: mcp/port-session/ (own package.json/tsconfig; root tsconfig EXCLUDES mcp). Its MCP tools/prompts are dispatched by NAME STRING via CallToolRequestSchema/ListTools/GetPrompt handlers — top false-positive source.
- NO test script and NO test framework in either package. NO .github/workflows CI. Proof of safety = `npm run build` (next build incl. tsc type-check) + `npm run mcp:build`, both green on a FRESH install.
- knip/ts-prune/depcheck are NOT installed — run via npx ONLY; NEVER add them to any package.json/lockfile.

DO:
1. DETECT: run `npx knip`, `npx ts-prune`, `npx depcheck` over BOTH projects (root and mcp/port-session/ separately). Capture raw output + resolved tool versions. Build a consolidated candidate list tagged file|export/symbol|dependency + detecting tool(s).
2. VERIFY every candidate (detection alone is NEVER sufficient): `git grep` the WHOLE repo — incl. Dockerfile, .dockerignore, install.sh, deploy/** (shell+Python+YAML/JSON), docs/** (incl. docs/mockups/*.html), *.css, both package.json files. Rule out: (a) framework entry points — src/app/**/page.tsx, layout.tsx, route.ts (~20 API route.ts files), loading/error/not-found, src/middleware.ts, next.config.mjs, postcss/tailwind/tsconfig, next-env.d.ts — these are LIVE BY DEFINITION, never remove even if flagged; (b) dynamic imports/reflection/name-string dispatch (esp. MCP handlers); (c) string references — Tailwind content-glob classes, public/ asset URL paths (/favicon.svg etc.), env keys from .env.example, file paths in Docker/install/deploy scripts; (d) public API — MCP bin (dist/index.js), tool/prompt schemas, surfaces documented in README/docs. Cross-project: a symbol unused in src/ but referenced from mcp/port-session/ (or vice-versa) is NOT dead.
3. REMOVE only verified-dead items. Deletion-only — no renames/refactors; minimal mechanical cleanup of a deletion allowed. Dependency removals: edit the correct package.json and regenerate its lockfile via npm (never hand-edit); don't drop a dep the other project uses.
4. KEEP anything uncertain — record as "kept — uncertain" with reason.
5. PROVE: fresh install, then `npm run build` and `npm run mcp:build` both green; re-check for any test runner added since 2026-08-31 and run it if found; otherwise record "No test runner present; proof is build + mcp:build". Capture logs.
6. LEDGER: draft the Removal Ledger per the template in requirements.md — one row per removed item (item | type | detected by | git-grep evidence + ruled-out dynamic-usage classes | proof) and one row per kept-uncertain candidate (candidate | flagged by | reason), plus proof-of-safety section and detection appendix.
7. Push sweep/dead-code-2026-08-31 and open the working PR into main with the ledger in the body. Do NOT merge; do NOT enable auto-merge.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA:
- Diff is removal-only; ledger removed-rows map 1:1 to deleted items; zero uncertain items removed; no entry-point/config/public-API file touched.
- No knip/ts-prune/depcheck (or helper) added to any manifest/lockfile (`git diff main -- '**/package.json' '**/package-lock.json'` clean of tooling deps).
- npm run build + npm run mcp:build green on fresh install, logs captured.
- Exactly one PR: base main, head sweep/dead-code-2026-08-31, Removal Ledger + proof + detection appendix in body, no auto-merge.
